title: 家庭与社交精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 等孩子睡着后，我们再收拾厨房。
items.en: We'll tidy the kitchen once the children are asleep.
answers: We'll tidy the kitchen once the children are asleep.
We will tidy the kitchen once the children are asleep.
items.notes: once 引导将来的时间从句时使用现在时；asleep 是形容词。

items.zh: 你能在回家的路上接一下奶奶吗？
items.en: Could you pick Grandma up on your way home?
answers: Could you pick Grandma up on your way home?
items.notes: pick sb up 表示接人；on your way home 中 home 前不加 to。

items.zh: 与其让一个人做所有家务，我们不如轮流做饭。
items.en: Instead of leaving all the housework to one person, we could take turns cooking.
answers: Instead of leaving all the housework to one person, we could take turns cooking.
items.notes: instead of 后接 doing；take turns doing 表示轮流做。

items.zh: 我原以为聚会是周六，结果是周五。
items.en: I thought the gathering was on Saturday, but it turned out to be on Friday.
answers: I thought the gathering was on Saturday, but it turned out to be on Friday.
items.notes: turn out to be 表示结果是；星期前用 on。

items.zh: 如果有人对坚果过敏，请提前告诉我。
items.en: Please let me know in advance if anyone is allergic to nuts.
answers: Please let me know in advance if anyone is allergic to nuts.
items.notes: be allergic to 表示对某物过敏；anyone 作主语时用 is。

items.zh: 我们已经有几个月没一起吃饭了。
items.en: We haven't had a meal together for several months.
answers: We haven't had a meal together for several months.
We have not had a meal together for several months.
items.notes: 现在完成时加 for + 一段时间，说明持续至今的情况。

items.zh: 门口那位戴红帽子的人是我表姐。
items.en: The person wearing a red hat by the door is my cousin.
answers: The person wearing a red hat by the door is my cousin.
items.notes: wearing ... 是现在分词定语；cousin 不区分堂表或性别。

items.zh: 既然你明天要早起，我们今晚就别待太晚了。
items.en: Since you need to get up early tomorrow, let's not stay too late tonight.
answers: Since you need to get up early tomorrow, let's not stay too late tonight.
items.notes: since 表示既然；let's not + 动词原形提出否定建议。

items.zh: 你想带朋友来参加晚餐也可以。
items.en: You're welcome to bring a friend to dinner.
answers: You're welcome to bring a friend to dinner.
You are welcome to bring a friend to dinner.
items.notes: be welcome to do 表示欢迎对方做某事；bring 强调带到说话者所在处。

items.zh: 生日礼物不必昂贵，重要的是让对方感到你很用心。
items.en: A birthday gift needn't be expensive; what matters is that it shows you've put thought into it.
answers: A birthday gift needn't be expensive; what matters is that it shows you've put thought into it.
A birthday gift need not be expensive; what matters is that it shows you have put thought into it.
items.notes: needn't + 动词原形表示不必；put thought into 表示认真考虑。

items.zh: 我会负责订餐厅，只要你能确认人数。
items.en: I'll book the restaurant as long as you can confirm how many people are coming.
answers: I'll book the restaurant as long as you can confirm how many people are coming.
I will book the restaurant as long as you can confirm how many people are coming.
items.notes: as long as 引导条件；how many 从句作 confirm 的宾语。

items.zh: 你帮忙照看孩子，让我们能够出去庆祝周年纪念日。
items.en: By looking after the children, you made it possible for us to go out and celebrate our anniversary.
answers: By looking after the children, you made it possible for us to go out and celebrate our anniversary.
items.notes: by doing 说明帮助的方式；make it possible for sb to do 中 it 为形式宾语。

items.zh: 我们能把家庭日程放在大家都看得到的地方吗？
items.en: Could we put the family schedule somewhere everyone can see it?
answers: Could we put the family schedule somewhere everyone can see it?
items.notes: somewhere 后接地点定语从句。

items.zh: 我来洗碗，你负责把剩菜收好。
items.en: I will wash the dishes, and you can put the leftovers away.
answers: I will wash the dishes, and you can put the leftovers away.
I'll wash the dishes, and you can put the leftovers away.
items.notes: put away：收拾存放。

items.zh: 孩子明天要带午饭，我们今晚得先准备好。
items.en: The children need packed lunches tomorrow, so we should prepare them tonight.
answers: The children need packed lunches tomorrow, so we should prepare them tonight.
items.notes: packed lunch：自带午餐。

items.zh: 请别把小零件放在幼儿够得到的地方。
items.en: Please keep small parts out of toddlers' reach.
answers: Please keep small parts out of toddlers' reach.
items.notes: out of reach：够不到。

items.zh: 如果你下班晚了，我可以先去接孩子。
items.en: If you finish work late, I can collect the children first.
answers: If you finish work late, I can collect the children first.
items.notes: collect 在此表示接人。

items.zh: 我们说好了，谁最后出门谁就检查门窗。
items.en: We agreed that whoever leaves last checks the doors and windows.
answers: We agreed that whoever leaves last checks the doors and windows.
items.notes: whoever 从句作嵌套主语。

items.zh: 我想邀请新邻居喝杯茶，认识一下他们。
items.en: I would like to invite our new neighbours for tea and get to know them.
answers: I would like to invite our new neighbours for tea and get to know them.
I'd like to invite our new neighbours for tea and get to know them.
items.notes: get to know：逐渐认识。

items.zh: 来之前发条消息就好，不需要带礼物。
items.en: Just send a message before coming; there is no need to bring a gift.
answers: Just send a message before coming; there is no need to bring a gift.
items.notes: there is no need to do：不必。

items.zh: 我忘记回复邀请了，现在还来得及确认吗？
items.en: I forgot to reply to the invitation; is it still possible to confirm now?
answers: I forgot to reply to the invitation; is it still possible to confirm now?
items.notes: reply to：回复。

items.zh: 这次聚会规模小一些，大家才有时间好好聊天。
items.en: Keeping this gathering small will give everyone time for a proper conversation.
answers: Keeping this gathering small will give everyone time for a proper conversation.
items.notes: keeping ... small 为动名词主语。

items.zh: 你愿意坐在里面，还是外面的院子里？
items.en: Would you prefer to sit indoors or outside in the courtyard?
answers: Would you prefer to sit indoors or outside in the courtyard?
items.notes: prefer to do：更愿意。

items.zh: 我们家吃饭时间比较早，你可能需要调整一下行程。
items.en: We eat fairly early, so you may need to adjust your plans.
answers: We eat fairly early, so you may need to adjust your plans.
items.notes: fairly：相当、比较。

items.zh: 我叔叔说话声音很大，但他并没有生气。
items.en: My uncle speaks loudly, but he is not angry.
answers: My uncle speaks loudly, but he is not angry.
My uncle speaks loudly, but he isn't angry.
items.notes: loudly 描述音量，不表示情绪。

items.zh: 我想先问问当事人，再把这个消息告诉其他人。
items.en: I want to ask the person concerned before sharing the news with anyone else.
answers: I want to ask the person concerned before sharing the news with anyone else.
items.notes: the person concerned：当事人。

items.zh: 虽然我们住得远，但每周都会约一次视频通话。
items.en: Although we live far apart, we arrange a video call every week.
answers: Although we live far apart, we arrange a video call every week.
items.notes: far apart：彼此相距很远。

items.zh: 照看父亲的安排，需要让每个参与的人都清楚。
items.en: The arrangements for looking after Dad need to be clear to everyone involved.
answers: The arrangements for looking after Dad need to be clear to everyone involved.
items.notes: everyone involved：所有参与者。

items.zh: 如果某项家务让你负担太重，我们可以重新分配。
items.en: If a household task is too much for you, we can redistribute the work.
answers: If a household task is too much for you, we can redistribute the work.
items.notes: too much for sb：超出负担。

items.zh: 我希望孩子参与决定，而不是替他们安排每件事。
items.en: I would like the children to take part in decisions rather than have everything arranged for them.
answers: I would like the children to take part in decisions rather than have everything arranged for them.
I'd like the children to take part in decisions rather than have everything arranged for them.
items.notes: have sth done：让事情被安排。

items.zh: 请在客人到之前留出一条能走动的通道。
items.en: Please leave a clear path before the guests arrive.
answers: Please leave a clear path before the guests arrive.
items.notes: a clear path：畅通的通道。

items.zh: 我们把合照发到群里之前，应该先征求大家同意。
items.en: We should ask everyone's permission before posting the group photograph.
answers: We should ask everyone's permission before posting the group photograph.
items.notes: ask permission：征求同意。

items.zh: 我不太记得他的名字，但记得在哪里见过他。
items.en: I cannot quite remember his name, but I remember where we met.
answers: I cannot quite remember his name, but I remember where we met.
I can't quite remember his name, but I remember where we met.
items.notes: cannot quite：不太能。

items.zh: 你们上次帮了我们，这次让我们来安排吧。
items.en: You helped us last time; let us make the arrangements this time.
answers: You helped us last time; let us make the arrangements this time.
items.notes: make arrangements：作出安排。

items.zh: 这次庆祝不需要很正式，大家舒服就好。
items.en: This celebration need not be formal; everyone's comfort matters more.
answers: This celebration need not be formal; everyone's comfort matters more.
This celebration needn't be formal; everyone's comfort matters more.
items.notes: need not：不必。

items.zh: 离开前，我会确认老人已经有人陪着。
items.en: Before leaving, I will make sure our elderly relative has someone with them.
answers: Before leaving, I will make sure our elderly relative has someone with them.
Before leaving, I'll make sure our elderly relative has someone with them.
items.notes: 单数 them 可指性别未说明的人。
